name: Intertech Products, Inc.
old_description: For the last 33 years, we have built our reputation on a strong culture of innovation. Our people and processes are committed to help find the easiest, fastest, safest, most cost-effective way, and best way to find solutions for our customers. That’s why we’ve been recognized consistently over the years with Suppler Performance Awards in the highly competitive fields of logistics, quality, commercial manufacturing, and service and engineering support.
about:
Intertech Products, Inc. operates from North Manchester, Indiana, where it has built a reputation over more than three decades. The company traces its roots back 33 years, though a specific founding year and founder names are not disclosed in public materials. Ownership structure — whether family, veteran, woman, or employee-owned — is not stated.

The company runs compression molding and extrusion coating and laminating operations, with additional capability in plastics processing and converting. Its quality system is certified to IATF 16949 and aligned with ISO 9001, and the organization employs AIAG core tools such as PFMEA, control plans, SPC, MSA, and PPAP. Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma methodologies support continuous improvement. Facility size, headcount, annual volumes, and part-number counts are not published.

Intertech explicitly serves the automotive industry, citing work with well-known American brands. A job posting for a quality manager also lists food manufacturing, food packaging, and GFSI, BRC, or SQF systems as preferred experience, suggesting exposure to that sector, though the company does not formally list it among industries served.

The firm says its differentiation comes from a culture of innovation, a safety program that exceeds standard practice, and a promote-from-within philosophy backed by tuition and technical-certification reimbursement. It highlights consistent Supplier Performance Awards in logistics, quality, commercial manufacturing, and service and engineering support as external validation of its approach.
